provenance.source: Existing native jar; synthetic definition span and exact isolated provider calls
syntheticInputs: VarpTypeList(null).size set reflectively before domain construction; no cache
Before each native time query: Utils.lastSystemTime=2^60 and Utils.timeOffset=desiredTime-2^60; native rollback compensation returns exact desiredTime
Only the helper is compiled with the existing jar's embedded Kotlin compiler; native jar is never rebuilt
provenance.isolation: bwrap --unshare-net; read-only host root; copied jar; empty temporary home; cleared environment; headless; bot disabled
provenance.scope: VARP_SMALL/VARP_LARGE payload readers plus provider only; no live dispatcher, host CS2, varbit, varc, persistence or gameplay
